title: On The Greater Healing Potion
summary: Contains the recipe for Potion of Greater Healing.

fields.Recipe: Extract three Balsam into Ashes of Balsam, then add any Salt.
fields.Acquisition: Last Light Inn X −63, Y 138, the Velveteen Elixir X −23, Y 141, or Bonecloak’s Apothecary X −39, Y −27.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
